divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

input: hand-built records at chromosome 21 sites of the GRCh38-release116 corpus's cache and one on chrM: the overlap-allele rules (an ALT equal to the reference, repeated ALTs, `*`, `<DEL:*>`, a `*` beside an allele under a true INFO/SVTYPE), the anchor chop and minimisation, the ID column, gVCF alleles, structural spans and breakends, the incomplete deletion, a tandem repeat whose SVLEN list ends in a comma, a structural record written with five columns in the short twin and a structural record whose QUAL is `0`, chromosome spellings, a contig no cache carries and POS 0; twins of the same records at five columns (one line with three trailing empty columns), with CRLF line ends, with a Latin-1 header and sample column, and on standard input
generator: json_cache: the GRCh38-release116 corpus's pruned cache plus the GRCh38-native-builder corpus's MT shard and the chromosome 21 and MT lines of the Ensembl cache's chr_synonyms.txt; expected outputs: one Ensembl VEP 116.2 container run per format per input; manifest: the records' consequence sets and skip warnings from the default output, scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py flag-set and classify (the manifest's run and every flag set)

pruned_cache.chr_synonyms: the 21 and MT lines of homo_sapiens/116_GRCh38/chr_synonyms.txt

short.reference_run: the manifest's run: the twin carries the same records, so expected/ is its reference; a container run on the twin wrote the same default, tab and VCF outputs and the same warning descriptions, each quoting the line as the twin spells it

crlf.reference_run: the manifest's run: the twin carries the same records, so expected/ is its reference; a container run on the twin wrote the same default, tab and VCF outputs and the same warning descriptions, each quoting the line as the twin spells it

latin1.reference_run: its own run on the twin; the default and tab outputs compared, the VCF header carrying the Latin-1 bytes as read and the JSON input the sample columns, neither a text the harness reads

stdin.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --allele_number --uploaded_allele --variant_class --mask_header_cache_path --format vcf [--tab|--vcf|--json]
stdin.reference_run: the manifest's run: the same file piped on standard input
